figures.finding: No performer's rate is set in Samoa; the only floor found is the private-sector minimum wage, WST 5.24 an hour from 1 July 2026, rising to 5.65 from 1 July 2027 and 6.05 from 1 July 2028 (Cabinet Directive FK(24)25 under the Labour and Employment Relations Amendment Act 2023).
figures.applies: Samoa, private-sector and state-owned-enterprise employees (public service excluded).

sources.said: The minimum wage in the private sector and state-owned enterprises is set per Cabinet Directive FK(24)25 , mandated under Section 32 of the Labour and Employment Relations Amendment Act 2023 ( i Gagana Samoa ). Current and upcoming rates: $5.24 per hour — effective 1 July 2026 (current) $5.65 per hour — effective 1 July 2027 $6.05 per hour — effective 1 July 2028

figures.finding: Debates in Samoa's Legislative Assembly are held in Samoan and English; no source names the language of screen work.

value.basis: constitution (Legislative Assembly languages), not a statement on film

sources.said: All debates and discussions in the Legislative Assembly shall be conducted in the Samoan language and the English language.
